trials.summary: w1_2d (sigma_weight 0.4092) reaches objective 0.0895, about 0.009 worse than the KDE control 0.0803, with no divergences and error concentrated in the low-count mu channel.
trials.key_insight: The bandwidth-free W1 loss is fully stable (no mu runaway, gamma finite) but recovers low-count mu worse than the KDE control, so it has not yet earned its keep.

trials.summary: energy_2d (sigma_weight 0.4228) reaches objective 0.0996, worse than trial_01 w1_2d (0.0895) and the KDE control (0.0803), no divergences, with a systematic low-count gamma undershoot.
trials.key_insight: The energy distance is stable but undershoots gamma in the low-count cells, making it the weakest loss form tested so far.

trials.summary: mmd_2d (sigma_weight 0.4331) reaches objective 0.1833, far worse than w1_2d (0.0895), energy_2d (0.0996) and the KDE control (0.0803), with mu low almost everywhere and no divergences.
trials.key_insight: With the median-heuristic MMD kernel the mu reward is systematically too weak, leaving mu far below truth at every transmission; MMD is the weakest loss form tested.

trials.summary: w1_fwhm (sigma_weight 0.5113) reaches objective 0.0908, statistically identical to the two-channel w1_2d (0.0895) and still worse than the KDE control (0.0803), with no divergences.
trials.key_insight: Dropping the sigma channel from the W1 loss changes the result essentially not at all (0.0908 vs 0.0895), so the W1 shortfall is a property of the FWHM loss itself, not of the sigma link.

trials.summary: cvm_fwhm (sigma_weight 0.2345) reaches objective 0.0777, a new campaign best that edges past the KDE control (0.0803), driven by the best gamma recovery of any trial.
trials.key_insight: A FWHM-only Cramer-von Mises loss currently beats the KDE control, with the gain coming from the gamma channel rather than mu, which stays low at high T.

trials.summary: cvm_fwhm (sigma_weight 0.2074) improves the campaign best to objective 0.0764, reproducing the family win over the KDE control (0.0803) with the best gamma of the campaign.
trials.key_insight: The cvm_fwhm advantage is reproducible across two seeds (0.0777 then 0.0764) and its benefit lives in the gamma channel, while mu stays at the same rel ~33 percent level as every other family.

trials.summary: The KDE control at sigma_weight 0.2279 gives objective 0.0830, no better than its own reference (0.0803) and clearly behind cvm_fwhm (0.0764), so the low-sw region does not by itself produce the gain.
trials.key_insight: The cvm_fwhm advantage is a genuine loss-FORM effect, not a sigma_weight-region artifact: KDE moved to the same sw stays at control level.

trials.summary: cvm_fwhm at sigma_weight 0.1816 gives objective 0.0791, still under the KDE control but worse than the same family at sw 0.2074 (0.0764), so the sw axis has a shallow minimum near 0.20-0.21.
trials.key_insight: cvm_fwhm sigma_weight response is non-monotone with a shallow minimum around sw ~0.20-0.21, so trial_06 setting is near the family optimum.

trials.summary: energy_2d at the winning sigma_weight (0.2291) gives objective 0.1021, no better than its high-sw value (0.0996) and clearly behind cvm_fwhm (0.0764), with the worst low-count gamma of the campaign.
trials.key_insight: The low-sw gain is specific to the cvm_fwhm loss form; the energy distance does not benefit from it, so the family ranking is not a sigma_weight artifact.

trials.summary: w1_2d at sigma_weight 0.2092 gives objective 0.0849, an improvement on its high-sw value (0.0895) but still behind the KDE control (0.0803) and well behind cvm_fwhm (0.0764).
trials.key_insight: The low-sw benefit is not exclusive to cvm_fwhm (w1_2d gains ~0.005 too), but cvm_fwhm gains roughly three times as much (0.013), so its lead reflects the loss form rather than sw alone.

trials.summary: cvm_fwhm at sigma_weight 0.1956 sets a new campaign best of 0.0760, bracketing the family optimum near sw ~0.20, with the campaign best gamma recovery.
trials.key_insight: The cvm_fwhm optimum is a flat basin around sw ~0.20 (0.0760-0.0764); its advantage over the KDE control is driven by better gamma, especially in the low-count cells.

trials.summary: w1_fwhm at sigma_weight 0.2079 gives objective 0.0923, no better than its high-sw value (0.0908), completing the low-sw map with cvm_fwhm as the sole family under the KDE control.
trials.key_insight: The FWHM-only W1 loss gains nothing from the low-sw region (0.0923 vs 0.0908), whereas its two-channel twin w1_2d does (0.0849) - the sigma link only pays off at low sw.

trials.summary: cvm_fwhm at sigma_weight 0.1910 sets a new campaign best of 0.0733, deepening the confirmed sw ~0.19 basin and putting the family ~0.007 under the KDE control.
trials.key_insight: The cvm_fwhm win is robust and reproducible (four points in 0.073-0.079 across sw 0.18-0.23), so it is the campaign clear winner over the KDE control.

trials.summary: cvm_fwhm at sigma_weight 0.1950 gives 0.0798, near-identical sw to trial_11 (0.0760), showing the basin seed scatter is ~0.004; the family sits at ~0.077 on average, just under the KDE control.
trials.key_insight: Within the flat cvm_fwhm basin the sw dependence is smaller than the seed scatter, so cvm_fwhm beats the control by a small (~0.003) but consistent margin.

trials.summary: The KDE control at sigma_weight 0.1895 gives objective 0.0866, no better than its own reference and well behind cvm_fwhm at the same sw, confirming the campaign winner is the Cramer-von Mises FWHM loss.
trials.key_insight: At matched sw KDE is flat/immune to the low-sw region while cvm_fwhm improves, so the ~0.004-0.010 cvm_fwhm advantage is the loss form, not the sigma_weight.

trials.summary: mmd_2d at sigma_weight 0.2029 gives 0.1755, essentially its high-sw value (0.1833), so MMD is sw-insensitive and by far the worst; this closes the family x sw matrix with cvm_fwhm the only family under the control.
trials.key_insight: MMD failure is a pure loss-form property (0.1755 low-sw vs 0.1833 high-sw), unaffected by sigma_weight - unlike cvm_fwhm, whose low-sw improvement is what carries the campaign win.

trials.summary: cvm_fwhm at sigma_weight 0.2048 gives 0.0781, a basin replication that brings the family mean to ~0.0772 (n=7) - consistently ~0.003 under the KDE control.
trials.key_insight: The cvm_fwhm basin is a stable ~0.0772 +/- 0.002 plateau, so the winner margin over the control is small but reproducible across seven independent draws.

trials.summary: cvm_fwhm at sigma_weight 0.3757 gives 0.0790, still under the KDE control, showing the family advantage is broad in sw (eight points spanning sw 0.18-0.38, all at or under the control).
trials.key_insight: cvm_fwhm is robustly competitive across a wide sw range, so its win is a broad loss-form advantage rather than a lucky narrow sw setting.

trials.summary: cvm_fwhm at sigma_weight 0.2030 gives 0.0840, its worst draw and the first above the KDE control, showing the basin scatter is larger than first estimated and the mean edge is only ~0.002.
trials.key_insight: The cvm_fwhm advantage is real on the mean (~0.078 over nine draws) but small and comparable to seed noise, so held-out validation is decisive.

trials.summary: cvm_fwhm at sigma_weight 0.2078 gives 0.0778, another basin replication bringing the family mean to ~0.0781 over ten draws, nine of which are under the KDE control.
trials.key_insight: The cvm_fwhm mean (~0.0781) sits ~0.002 under the control, a small but mostly consistent margin; the held-out set will decide its significance.

trials.summary: cvm_fwhm at sigma_weight 0.2011 gives 0.0773, another basin draw taking the family mean to ~0.0780 over eleven points (ten under the KDE control).
trials.key_insight: The cvm_fwhm mean is stable at ~0.078 - a small (~0.002), mostly consistent edge over the KDE control.

trials.summary: cvm_fwhm at sigma_weight 0.2049 gives 0.0799, keeping the family mean at ~0.0781 (eleven of twelve under the KDE control).
trials.key_insight: The basin holds its ~0.078 mean across twelve draws; the margin over the control remains small (~0.002) and consistent.

trials.summary: cvm_fwhm at sigma_weight 0.2006 gives 0.0777, keeping the family mean at ~0.0780 over thirteen draws (twelve under the KDE control).
trials.key_insight: The basin mean stays pinned at ~0.078; the winner edge over the control is a small, consistent ~0.002.

trials.summary: cvm_fwhm at sigma_weight 0.1997 gives 0.0778, keeping the family mean at ~0.0780 over fourteen draws.
trials.key_insight: The winner basin mean is stable at ~0.078, a small, consistent ~0.002 edge over the KDE control.

trials.summary: cvm_fwhm at sigma_weight 0.1972 sets a new campaign best of 0.0725, ~0.008 under the KDE control, further confirming the sw ~0.19-0.20 basin.
trials.key_insight: The cvm_fwhm basin floor is ~0.072-0.073 near sw 0.19-0.20, with a stable mean ~0.0776 over fifteen draws - a small but consistent winner over the control.

trials.summary: cvm_fwhm at sigma_weight 0.1979 gives 0.0727, reproducing the campaign best (0.0725) and confirming the sw ~0.198 basin floor is ~0.0725-0.073, ~0.008 under the KDE control.
trials.key_insight: The winner best region is reproducible across seeds (0.0725 then 0.0727), so the cvm_fwhm edge over the control is genuine at the basin floor.

trials.summary: cvm_fwhm at sigma_weight 0.1946 gives 0.0833, above the control, showing the basin scatter (~0.004) makes single-trial comparisons unreliable even at the best sw.
trials.key_insight: Only the family mean (~0.077 over seventeen draws) is below the control; individual draws can exceed 0.083, so the winner must be judged on many draws and held-out validation.

trials.summary: cvm_fwhm at sigma_weight 0.1958 gives 0.0760, under the control, keeping the family mean at ~0.0773 over eighteen draws (sixteen under the control).
trials.key_insight: The winner mean edge over the control is small (~0.003) but holds on sixteen of eighteen draws, while single draws can cross the control.

trials.summary: cvm_fwhm at sigma_weight 0.1924 gives 0.0799, under the control, keeping the family mean at ~0.0774 over nineteen draws (seventeen under the control).
trials.key_insight: With one trial left the conclusion is stable: cvm_fwhm is the only family whose mean beats the KDE control, by ~0.003.

trials.summary: The final trial, cvm_fwhm at sigma_weight 0.1988 -> 0.0794, closes the campaign with the Cramer-von Mises FWHM loss as the only family whose mean (~0.0775 over twenty draws) beats the KDE control.
trials.key_insight: Across the whole campaign only cvm_fwhm beat the control, by a small (~0.003) but mostly consistent margin concentrated in the gamma channel.

protocol.model: series-21 (17g) model on REAL data; the mu reward and the gamma pathwise channel are both derived from the selected distributional LOSS (loss_family); mu score denominator = per-experiment sigma_prop (MU_SCORE=sigma_prop)
protocol.question: experiment_8 - loss-FUNCTION campaign: the schedule (exp5 winner), the bandwidth (exp7 winner) and the gamma trust region (exp6 winner) are FROZEN; the campaign tunes the distributional loss (loss_family) and the sigma-channel weight (sigma_weight).
protocol.no_clipping: CLIP = inf AND parameter clamps removed (mu/gamma unbounded)

divergence_guard.note: STOP the experiment and record diverged/diverged_at if a parameter leaves this band

protocol.objective: T-weighted mean of CAP-capped per-cell rel-sq errors; err_i = min(rel_sq_i, CAP=1.0); w(T) = 0.25 + 0.75*T/100; objective = sum(w*err)/sum(w)

budget.held_out: 6 exps (1nW/3nW x Trans10/40/80) - post-campaign validation only

frozen: z-form gamma-score convention (kept for the control)
tunable: loss_family   choice  kde | w1_2d | energy_2d | mmd_2d | w1_fwhm | cvm_fwhm
sigma_weight  float   0.0 .. 1.0   (weight of the sigma_fit channel: loss = loss_FWHM + sw*loss_sigma)

families.kde: 2-D KDE negative log-likelihood (exp5/6/7 design) - CONTROL, reproduces exp6 0.0803
families.w1_2d: Wasserstein-1 (sorted quantile matching) on FWHM + sigma_fit - bandwidth-free
families.energy_2d: energy distance on FWHM + sigma_fit - bandwidth-free
families.mmd_2d: RBF-kernel MMD^2 over the 2-D cloud, median-heuristic kernel width (per step)
families.w1_fwhm: Wasserstein-1 on FWHM only (drops the sigma link) - control
families.cvm_fwhm: Cramer-von Mises-style squared quantile distance on FWHM only - control

protocol.family_scale: each family is multiplied by FAMILY_SCALE so its |d(loss)/dgamma| at the frozen start matches the KDE control (compares the loss FORM, not its scale)
protocol.success_bar: beat the experiment_6 level (objective ~0.086, best 0.0803) on the same T-weighted capped metric, with gamma finite on all 8 cells; the winner must ALSO hold on the 6 held-out experiments.
